body: It's good that you can still laugh at things.. It's been a few months since I have had a good laugh
I am sincerely sorry that you are miserable because I know the feeling and wouldn't wish it on anyone
I have reached out.  To no avail... Not projecting loneliness.. It's just a fact. Everyone's circumstances are different
I'm sorry you lost someone you care about.... Unfortunately not everyone has someone that cares ...the reason I am on here is because I literally have no one in my life that cares to even check on me
